cepi.g: yāva na niṭṭhāti, tāva punadivasepi katheti.
purato ṭhite dve sālarukkhe dassento parikappopamaṁ āha.
imaṁ dhammadesanaṁ Satthā Jetavane viharanto Santatimahāmattaṁ ārabbha kathesi.
yo vassasataṁ atikkamitvā jīvati, so ekaṁ vā vassaṁ jīvati.
Tattha abhijjhāyati etāyāti abhijjhā, parabhaṇḍābhijjhāyanalakkhaṇassa lobhassetaṁ adhivacanaṁ.

cittato aññaṁ vā idañca idañca nāma ahosi bhavati bhavissatīti bahukampi katheti.
cetopariyañāṇassa cittacetasikānaṁyeva ārammaṇakaraṇato sarāgādisoḷasapabhedavaseneva bahuṁ cepi katheti, na aññavasenāti veditabbaṁ.

cepī.g: imaṁ dhammadesanaṁ Satthā Jetavane viharanto Santatimahāmattaṁ ārabbha kathesi.
